question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

JDZW, NWDA, RPHE, ? , ZBPM
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• **First, third and fourth letter **⇒ (4) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• **Second letter ⇒ **(7) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dbb02207fae7b8de6dd66dd540b240e8424ca52f128bcad0efb6d1a2557eeab.png] 

​Hence, "**VILI**" is the correct answer.
